subject: Coordination: global demo — staggered / split sessions to avoid APAC Golden Week
messages:
From: Tom Liang <tom@kumoanalytics.com>
To: ava_chen@redwood.com
Cc: calendar@kumoanalytics.com
Date: Thu, 22 Apr 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Quick: global demo week of May?

Hi Ava,

Thanks for the initial outreach — we'd like to lock a date for the platform demo. Our regional stakeholders are: Tokyo product (3), Bangalore integrators (2), London lead (1), and SF engineering (2). Week of May 10-14 looks best for most of the company, but I flagged a potential problem: our Tokyo office has internal coverage changes around Golden Week (they'll be back in early May but some folks take staggered days off).

Could Redwood run either a single consolidated demo that accommodates everyone or two shorter, region-friendly sessions? Also please share an agenda and a mutual action plan (we need to align procurement and security review checkpoints).

Attaching current internal attendee list (we'll follow up with exact names).

Best,
Tom
Kumo Analytics

Attachments: attendee-list.csv (stated)

From: ava_chen@redwood.com
To: Tom Liang <tom@kumoanalytics.com>
Cc: neha_kapoor@redwood.com, marcus_lin@redwood.com
Date: Fri, 23 Apr 2027 11:04:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Quick: global demo week of May?

Hi Tom — thanks for the context, and great to hear Kumo is ready to move forward.

Two pragmatic options from our side to avoid forcing people into a bad local time during Golden Week / EU bank holidays:

1) Split demo into two 45-minute sessions the same day (technical deep-dive + product overview). This reduces late-night exposure for APAC and keeps London/SF overlap.
2) Two half-days on consecutive days: APAC-friendly morning and EMEA/US-friendly afternoon.

I attached a 1-page demo agenda and a draft mutual action plan (starts shipping procurement items and SOC 2 evidence checkpoints). Marcus and Neha — can you confirm capacity for two back-to-back sessions on May 12?

Proposed tentative slots (all in UTC to avoid DST confusion):
- Option A: May 12, 01:00 UTC (APAC-preferred) + May 12, 13:00 UTC (EU/US preferred)
- Option B: May 13, 02:00 UTC + May 13, 14:00 UTC — if the 12th conflicts with any internal OOO.

If that works I can send calendar invites segmented by region and include recording/closed captions.

Cheers,
Ava Chen
Enterprise Solutions
Redwood Inference

Attachments: redwood-demo-agenda.pdf, mutual-action-plan-KUMO-3472.xlsx

From: Tom Liang <tom@kumoanalytics.com>
To: ava_chen@redwood.com
Cc: Kathy Nguyen <kathy.nguyen@kumoanalytics.com>, calendar@kumoanalytics.com
Date: Fri, 23 Apr 2027 20:17:00 +09:00
Subject: Re: Quick: global demo week of May?

Ava — appreciate the options. Quick clarifications from our side:
- Tokyo team will indeed be out in a staggered way for Golden Week (end of April / first days of May) which is why we prefer the week of May 10–14. May 12 could work but I need to confirm specific Tokyo attendee availability.
- Bangalore folks are fine with afternoons UTC; London prefers morning UTC.

I like Option A (same day, two sessions). Can you do the shorter/targeted agendas per session (one for integrators, one for product/exec)? If you can share Zoom + recording plan we can provision a room and confirm headcounts.

Also: FYI our procurement lead is on leave May 17–21, so any legal redlines that require her signature should happen before then.

Thanks — I'll confirm exact Tokyo attendees by Monday.

Tom

From: marcus_lin@redwood.com
To: ava_chen@redwood.com, Tom Liang <tom@kumoanalytics.com>
Cc: neha_kapoor@redwood.com, soojin_lee@redwood.com
Date: Mon, 26 Apr 2027 02:11:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Quick: global demo week of May?

Tom, Ava — we can staff two staggered sessions on May 12. A couple operational notes:
- We'll run the sessions from the same meeting link to simplify recording; sessions will be clearly labeled in the invite.
- If US attendees switch off DST in early November, some recurring slots shift — for this one-off demo in May that won't matter, but worth noting for follow-ups.

Concrete slots we can commit to now (UTC):
- Session 1 (APAC primary): May 12, 01:00–01:45 UTC — agenda: platform walkthrough + integrations (target: Tokyo, Bangalore)
- Session 2 (EMEA/US): May 12, 13:00–13:45 UTC — agenda: product roadmap + procurement Q&A (target: London, SF)

We will bring: Solutions engineer (Neha) for the integration session, and Product lead (Marcus) for the exec session. Soojin will handle recording + invite logistics.

Marcus
Director, Solutions
Redwood Inference

From: soojin_lee@redwood.com
To: Tom Liang <tom@kumoanalytics.com>, ava_chen@redwood.com
Cc: marcus_lin@redwood.com, neha_kapoor@redwood.com
Date: Mon, 26 Apr 2027 17:58:00 +09:00
Subject: Re: Quick: global demo week of May?

Thanks — I created two provisional calendar invites and segmented guest lists per session. I included the redwood-demo-agenda.pdf and MAP link in the invites. Calendar invites:
- "Kumo — Redwood Demo (Integrations)" — May 12, 01:00 UTC — attendees: Tokyo engineers, Bangalore integrators
- "Kumo — Redwood Demo (Exec/Product)" — May 12, 13:00 UTC — attendees: London product, SF engineering, procurement

Zoom link is in the invite; recording will be posted to the Drive folder in 24 hours after the session. Tom, if you need a separate recording or an AWS-only demo snapshot we can schedule that as a follow-up.

Soojín Lee
Program Ops
Redwood Inference

From: Tom Liang <tom@kumoanalytics.com>
To: ava_chen@redwood.com, soojin_lee@redwood.com
Cc: Kathy Nguyen <kathy.nguyen@kumoanalytics.com>, calendar@kumoanalytics.com
Date: Mon, 26 Apr 2027 20:03:00 +09:00
Subject: Confirmed: May 12 split sessions

Ava / Soojín / Marcus — thanks for the quick turn.

We confirm: May 12 double session (01:00 UTC and 13:00 UTC). Tokyo will send two engineers to the 01:00 UTC slot; Bangalore will send one integrator to join as well. London and SF will join the 13:00 UTC slot; procurement will attend the second session for Q&A.

We have the attachments and the MAP — procurement will review the doc and flag any redlines by May 5. Please send the final calendar invites with dial-in + recording consent language.

See you then — looking forward.

Tom
Head of Integrations
Kumo Analytics
